newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Progressive 2nd qtr sales fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Progressive 2nd qtr sales fall slightly.

text.p: Progressive Enterprises Ltd said on Wednesday total sales for the second quarter ending January 26 were NZ$550.22 million compared to $566.33 million for the previous corresponding period.
Actual sales for year to date were $1.068 billion compared to $1.087 billion for the previous corresponding period.
On a comparable sales basis, second quarter sales were $547.345 million compared to $557.123 million for the previous corresponding period.
Year to date on a comparable basis was $1.038 billion compared to $1.050 billion for the previous year.

"Foodtown continued its strong performance reporting another quarterly increase in excess of five percent. The sales performance in Countdown, 3 Guys and Rattrays whilst below last year were in line with expectations," Progressive said in a statement.
"Georgie Pie sales continued to decline, with a total of six restaurants having been transferred to McDonalds.
"The remaining eleven restaurants subject to sale agreement are scheduled to transfer during the third quarter," it said.
